description: Tag-free wall/floor segmentation (LR-ASPP MobileNetV3-Large, 5 classes), seg-v2 fine-tuned on static renders under 24 random floor/light/wall looks + floor_light_v1 + default, plus replayed VIS3 TRAIN frames; robust to floor colour/brightness in the B1 checkpoint protocol (offline, simulator renders only)
verified_scope: B1 checkpoint protocol on floor_light_v1 and four held-out floor/wall looks, look p20, 480x360 inference: 9/9 checkpoints (position p90 <= 5 cm and yaw p90 <= 2 deg). Static simulator renders only; real floor/walls unmeasured.
limitations: Simulator renders only; the real room's floor and wall colours, texture, lighting and shadows were not measured.
Only the p20 look pose is reliable; the search pose (SEARCH_POSE) still has silent 6-14 cm x-biases at checkpoints 3-5 of robot r1 (far-wall edge, thin wall strip).
640x480 inference is NOT a drop-in: it fixes search but breaks p20 checkpoint 2 (12 cm).
Trained/evaluated on one map (zone_wide_door_geometry_v2, 0.40 m walls, no tags).
